same as others have said - uBlock Origin (Origin, not the other fork) and/or uMatrix - both by the same dev and i use both together, which is perfectly fine as long as they're configured correctly

uBlock O i use primarily for ad blocking while i use uMatrix for more granular control (scripts, 3rd party frames, local storage (cookies), XHR, etc.)

if you block scripts by default with either of the above, you probably do not need NoScript
